env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: this component explores the application’s navigation space, effectively mining a site-map-like structure
env_context_strategy.note: Browser agent navigates; knowledge injection layer adds site-map context.

observation_format.evidence_quote: constructs its observation space from both screenshots and the accessibility tree

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: the Action Agent, which executes browser interactions using tools such as Click, Type, Select, and Go Back
edit_primitive.note: Tool list is browser actions only; no file-editing primitive described.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Each application is backed by its own MCP server, which is automatically generated from its OpenAPI specification.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Each application is backed by its own MCP server

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Our initial iteration implemented a simple Plan-Act-Observe agentic loop
loop_primitives.note: Final architecture uses Plan Controller plus Sub-task Plan-Execute Agents.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: high-level planning, decomposing complex tasks into sub-tasks, selecting optimal sub-task sequencing

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the Plan Controller Agent managed the overall task flow. At the same time, the Sub-task Plan-Execute Agents handled the specifics

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: passing variables between sub-tasks to maintain continuity and context across the execution flow

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: we plan to further evolve CUGA to be a safe and policy-compliant, as well as a collaborative and trustworthy AI agent with human-in-the-loop support

short_term_state.evidence_quote: A system-wide variable tracking framework was introduced, allowing the Plan Controller Agent to pass and update variables across sub-tasks

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: We have begun experimenting with methods to enable CUGA to learn from unstructured documents
long_term_memory.note: Cross-run persisted memory not described; learning from documents is experimental.

self_verification.evidence_quote: we incorporated reflection, critique, and judgment techniques within several of our agents
self_verification.note: Also a Reflection Judge in the Browser Planner.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The API agent was augmented with a reflection mechanism, enabling it to re-evaluate and revise its strategy in response to unexpected outputs or execution failures.
retry_policy.note: Step-level reflective loop; task-level retry policy not stated.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: tracking sub-task progress, determining task completion

cost_controls.evidence_quote: LangChain3, which provides a unified interface for interacting with a mix of open and frontier LLMs
cost_controls.note: Mix of models per agent; explicit budget/caching not reported.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: It uses Playwright to control the browser
execution_isolation.note: Browser/MCP-server execution; isolation boundary not stated.

permission_model.evidence_quote: how agents can reason about, restrict, and validate API usage in alignment with enterprise policies and security constraints

tracing.evidence_quote: visualizing the agent’s interaction with the environment, its perception, reasoning process, and actions taken by different components

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: we implemented a parallel execution framework. This framework allows us to run multiple evaluations concurrently
eval_hooks.note: Uses BrowserGym official evaluation suite for WebArena.

guardrails.evidence_quote: the introduction of dedicated reflection and judgment agents. This dual approach allowed us to address both the underlying reasoning processes and the final outputs

target_domain.evidence_quote: Our first version focuses on knowledge worker tasks within web applications
target_domain.note: API sub-agent via MCP covers general tool use.

open_source.evidence_quote: we are leveraging insights, methodologies, and tools from initiatives like IBM CUGA and others, integrating and hardening them into the observability and analytics layers of the IBM Agentic Middleware platform
open_source.note: No repository or licence given in the evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: LangChain3, which provides a unified interface for interacting with a mix of open and frontier LLMs

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Towards Enterprise-Ready Computer Using Generalist Agent
